commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The identifiers entry_is_line_a, entry_is_line_b, entry_is_line_c, entry_is_line_d, and entry_is_line_e are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 76 encoded the section 232 aluminum / reciprocal-metals predicate as hts_number == "7601.10.30.00", one unwrought-aluminum line standing in for the whole membership, and the other four predicates as out-of-chapter exemplar lines, so the aluminum and section 301 components fired for exactly one chapter 76 line and were zero for all the other aluminum articles the cited heading 9903.01.33 text covers ('articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum').
triage.triage_notes: Same hunk pattern as index 72, with one chapter-specific wrinkle worth recording: unlike the other chunk modules, exemplar line b (7601.10.30.00) IS a chapter 76 line, so the pre-fix defect here is under-inclusiveness (a single line standing for an entire section 232 membership) rather than an entirely foreign-chapter condition; the other four exemplars (7202, 9506, 2203, 8541) remain out of chapter. Verified the post-fix file still references entry_is_line_* 20 times with no local definitions. Same doubt as index 72.
triage.verifier_justification: The ch76 diff contains nothing but the summary rewrite and the deletion of the five `entry_is_line_a..e` derived rules; every meaning-bearing consumer is byte-identical after the commit (`entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` is still `formula: entry_is_line_b`, `section_232_aluminum_component_rate` still branches `elif entry_is_line_b:`, and the five-term §301 sum is unchanged), so this commit relocates where a flag is defined rather than re-grounding any duty predicate on the 9903.01.33 membership. Two pieces of evidence cut against the "fidelity correction" reading: the identical exemplar proxy `entry_is_energy_resource` = `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` (a chapter 72 ferroalloy line cited to the 9903.01.13 energy scope) survives untouched at post-commit line 1986, and the maintainer's own PR comment says flags a/b/d were *retained* as exemplar input slots, so the aluminum/metals predicate the first reader's reading turns on was never moved to membership semantics by this PR. The pre state was genuinely narrower than the resolved 9903.01.33 text ("articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum … as provided in subdivisions (v)(vi) through (v)(xvi) of U.S. note 2"), and removing four out-of-chapter line bindings (footballs, beer, PV cells, ferroalloy) from an aluminum module does unfreeze branches that were dead-false for every real chapter-76 entry — which is why I do not call it mechanical or not_a_defect. But with a generic structural commit subject, PR gates certifying byte-exact determinism and witness-slice equivalence "exact under input mapping", and no consumer formula touched, the evidence does not settle that this module change corrects encoded meaning rather than plumbing it out to a caller.
triage.verifier_quote: companion tests now feed only the retained exemplar flags (a/b/d) — c and e are fully replaced and no longer valid input slots
triage.verifier_notes: Verification trail. (1) Diff (075.diff, 124 lines) = summary paragraph + removal of five derived rules only; no other hunks. (2) Post-commit ch76 still references all five identifiers unchanged: line 1959 `- formula: entry_is_line_b` under `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` (source "HTS 9903.01.33 section 232 metals article scope"), line 2786 `elif entry_is_line_b:` in `section_232_aluminum_component_rate`, lines 3029-3033 the five-slot §301 sum, lines 2607/3074/3232 `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0`. (3) Provision check via resolve_provision (corpus release us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, provision sha 906509af…): 9903.01.33 text is a broad class list, confirming the pre-fix one-line binding was under-inclusive — so the first reader's *reading of the pre state* is factually correct. (4) Counter-evidence that this commit is not the correction: `entry_is_energy_resource` remains `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` post-commit (line 1986) despite citing the 9903.01.13 energy/critical-minerals scope, i.e. the exemplar-proxy class of defect is still in the module after the "fix"; and the module's own scope statement for the aluminum component reads "Flat ad-valorem section 232 aluminum overlay composition for HTS 7601.10.30.00", so that component never claimed chapter-wide coverage. (5) If a reviewer keeps this case, untraceable_branch is still the best-fitting kind (removal of conditions grounded on other chapters' HTS lines — footballs 9506.62.40.40, beer 2203.00.00.30, PV cells 8541.42.00.10 — inside an aluminum module); wrong_entity_or_scope is the runner-up. Mechanical is wrong regardless: five derived outputs were removed and five caller inputs added (PR: "−500 removed exemplar-flag outputs"). The real fidelity repair described in the PR body (§122 decoupling, per-list China gating, the new `section_232_steel_component_rate`) lands in sibling commits of PR #1300, not in 2a6bdb01de's ch76 diff — a reviewer may want to screen those commits instead.
